AI.DefaultCuisineExtractionPrompt: Extract all cuisine types mentioned in the user prompt. Return a JSON object with a single property named "cuisines" whose value is an array of strings, for example {"cuisines":["italian"]}. Return nothing else.
AI.DefaultIngredientExtractionPrompt: Extract all grocery/food ingredients mentioned in the user prompt. Return a JSON object with a single property named "ingredients" whose value is an array of strings, for example {"ingredients":["red onions","peppers"]}. Use one entry per distinct ingredient in the order mentioned and keep the user's own wording, dropping quantities, units, and prep. Return nothing else.

ExtractionChallenges.Prompt: I have some cut up red onions and peppers for fajitas, but I don't feel like making fajitas.
I have ground beef, rice, and carrots, and I don't know what to cook for dinner.
I want something healthy tonight. I have some chicken breast and broccoli that needs to be used soon. I have a guest with a gluten allergy.

AI.IdeaGenerationPrompt: You are a family meal planner. Given a list of ingredients, identify 3 recognizable dishes or meal types that can be made from them. The dishes should incorporate as many of the key ingredients as possible, with remaining ingredients being common household staples. The dish name and recipe should be similar or identical to recipes that are common in cookbooks. Return a JSON object with a single property named "ideas" whose value is an array of recipe name strings, for example {"ideas":["Beef & Carrot Fried Rice","Korean-Style Beef Rice Bowls"]}. Return nothing else.
AI.RecipeGenerationPrompt: You are a chef. Given a meal idea, key ingredients, and format rules, generate one complete recipe as a single strict JSON object with these top-level properties: name, description, servingCount, prepTimeMinutes, cookTimeMinutes, difficulty, optional notes, ingredients (ordered array of objects with order, optional quantity, optional unit, name, optional group, optional note), and steps (ordered array of objects with order, instruction, optional group). The format rules describe the standard v1 field limits; output the info fields at the top level, not under an info wrapper. Leave group blank for the main recipe and use a short label such as Sauce or Marinade only when the dish has parts. Return ONLY JSON with no prose, commentary, markdown code fences, or intro text.
